text: The team assigned MEE014 to investigate rechargeable batteries.
The meeting highlighted problems including stock shortages of components and materials and the current lack of a rechargeable battery option.
There is uncertainty about the life/duration of kinetic charging and a need to confirm solar charging compatibility with standard batteries and a dual power option.
Decisions were made to conduct market research on the closing feature attachment, omit voice recognition, adopt a flip design, and adopt kinetic charging for the battery.
